name: FinancesOnline

sources.title: FinancesOnline homepage - B2B software review platform
Add Your B2B or SaaS Product To Our Software Review Platform
App Launcher third-party profile describing FinancesOnline submission (free to submit)

conditions: Listing requires editorial acceptance into a B2B software category; the product must be a B2B/SaaS or financial product
The add-product page exposes a vendor listing form that requires JavaScript; no public pricing for the base listing is shown on the page
Third-party directory profiles describe the submission as free with paid upgrades, but FinancesOnline's own page does not confirm a free tier
requirements: Product must fit one of the B2B software categories (CRM, help desk, accounting, project management, marketing software, etc.) — this is a B2B/SaaS review platform, not a general directory
Platform positions itself around expert reviews plus real user reviews; a listing implies readiness for public user ratings
The listing form on /add-product/ requires JavaScript and could not be inspected from static HTML
preparation: Product name, vendor/company details, and product website URL
Category selection from the FinancesOnline taxonomy
Product description, key features, and pricing details
Logo and product screenshots (standard vendor-kit assets; exact specs not published on the page)
Contact details for follow-up from their review/marketing team
workflow: Go to https://financesonline.com/add-product/ (linked as 'GET LISTED' in the site header)
Complete the 'Create a Listing for Your Product' form (JavaScript-rendered; use a real browser)
Submit and wait for the FinancesOnline team to review and create the product profile
Expect follow-up contact — vendor testimonials describe an assigned account manager and paid marketing cooperation
watchFor: The platform's business model is paid B2B marketing — expect outreach pitching premium placement, PPC-style lead programs, and review acceleration after a free listing request
The form is JS-gated: plain HTML fetches show 'JavaScript is required for this content' instead of fields
There is also a /write-for-us/ guest-post channel — do not confuse it with product listing
A listing subjects the product to public expert scoring and user reviews that are hard to remove later
countsAsLive: A public product review page exists under reviews.financesonline.com or the product appears in its category listing with a score and 'Visit Website' link
unknowns: Exact fields in the JS-rendered listing form
Whether a genuinely free permanent listing exists or all listings route into paid vendor programs
Review turnaround time and rejection criteria
Whether the outbound link is dofollow (catalog note says follow; not confirmed on site)
